statement: There are n cities, numbered 0 to n − 1. graph holds the count n and a list of edges [a, b], each a direct connection between two cities.

Connections carry through: if a is connected to b and b to c, then a and c are connected too. A province is a group of cities connected to one another, directly or indirectly, and to no city outside the group.

examples.explanation: Cities 0 and 1 form one province and cities 2 and 3 form another; nothing links the two pairs.
There are no connections at all, so each of the six cities is its own province.
